rules.logic: ABIOC(ITDR-009 Sign-In Auth-Velocity and New-ASN Deviation from Learned Identity Baseline) AND ABIOC(ITDR-009 Impossible-Travel Geo-Velocity Deviation from Learned Sign-In Baseline) — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations on the same user into a single account-takeover incident anchored to the valid-account sign-in causality chain.
rules.name: Sign-In Account Takeover on a Learned Identity Baseline — ABIOC Causality Stitch
